From FUD to Differentiation

Every competitive deal comes with noise — claims, objections, and FUD (Fear, Uncertainty, Doubt) that competitors use against SAP. BattleCoach helps you cut through it with two battle-tested frameworks:

🛡️ AREA Framework (Defensive)

  • Acknowledge — Validate their concern
  • Reframe — Shift the perspective
  • Evidence — Ground with proof
  • Ask — Hand them a new question

⚔️ IDEA Framework (Offensive)

  • Insight — Lead with a surprising truth
  • Differentiator — What only you can do
  • Evidence — Prove it's real
  • Ask — Reframe the criteria
